cardinality.rule: setOptions: a viewport has no setOptions: set a display area with viewport.setViewState({ displayArea }); the other options are set once, in defaultOptions at enableElement
reset: a viewport has no reset: viewport.resetViewState() goes back to the display area of defaultOptions or of setViewState given with storeAsInitialCamera: true
options: a viewport has no options: read viewport.defaultOptions (the options of enableElement) or viewport.getViewState().displayArea
